niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, spacious, app-like interfaces with strong section hierarchy, concise and specific copy, and clearly visible controls. They like screens that feel finished and polished rather than prototype-like, with enough content density to feel complete but not so much that the layout feels crowded. They also prefer calm, friendly, reassuring tone in modal/alert flows, and they respond well to clear primary actions and explicit status/context.

criteria.description: Prefers interfaces with clearly separated sections, strong title-first structure, and obvious grouping between content areas.
Prefers layouts that feel open and balanced, but still populated enough to avoid empty, stubbed, or unfinished-looking screens.
Prefers short, direct, and specific explanatory text over verbose, generic, or overly instructional copy.
Prefers straightforward controls that are easy to scan and understand, such as single toggles, clear CTAs, and item-level actions.
Prefers a refined, modern, app-like visual style that feels finished, credible, and not prototype-like or promotional.
Prefers screens that stay focused on the task at hand, avoiding large decorative imagery, extra chrome, banners, or competing elements.
Prefers a single obvious primary action with strong visual prominence and clear affordance.
In modal and warning flows, prefers calm, empathetic, reassuring presentation over harsh, urgent, or alarmist styling.
